paper_metadata.title: A High Efficiency Broadband Class-E Power Amplifier Using a Reactance Compensation Technique
paper_metadata.abstract: This letter presents a high efficiency broadband fully integrated class-E power amplifier (PA) using a 0.5 m enhancement/depletion-pseudomorphic high-electron mobility transistor (E/D-PHEMT) process. The proposed PA is based on a class-E topology with a reactance compensation technique. To achieve high efficiency and broad bandwidth, the reactance compensation component is employed in the load network of the class-E PA. From 1.5 to 3.8 GHz, this circuit demonstrates a power added efficiency (PAE) of 62% and an output 1 dB compression point Fig. 1. sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: A high efﬁciency broadband class-E PA with a reactance compensation technique has been successfully developed in E/D-PHEMT process. From 1.5 to 3.8 GHz, the a 0.5 proposed class-E PA demonstrates an average efﬁciency of above 62% with an output power higher than 27 dBm.
